title: Brand personality / driver at work
slide_intent: Ground abstract brand traits in a person doing the work so viewers can understand them concretely.
strategic_value: A driver at the controls can connect DB’s responsibility and customer focus to lived railway activity.
demonstration: A photograph of a driver’s arm and control desk precedes text explaining brand personality and a link to its guidance.
practical_value: Choose an operational detail that makes a stated personality credible.

content_islands.name: Operational photograph
content_islands.spec: Place the cropped driver and control desk above the text.

content_islands.name: Personality explanation
content_islands.spec: Connect the image to responsibility, performance and customer orientation, then link to further guidance.

reference_purposes.Expression: The operational photograph gives the personality explanation a concrete railway setting.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying paragraph says personality provides orientation for behavior, design and communication.
